findings.evidence: The diff deletes all five `.lean` files; `rg --files code/TauCeti/NumberTheory/EffectiveBounds` no longer lists those module paths.
findings.fix: Restore compatibility shim modules for `UnitSquaresCorollaries`, `ClassNumberUnitSquares`, `QuadraticDiscriminant`, `QuadraticClassNumber`, and `QuadraticClassNumberUnitSquares` that only `public import` the new parent module, or provide an explicit staged deprecation plan.
findings.issue: Deleting the five public wrapper modules breaks downstream code that imports their module paths, even though the declaration names moved unchanged.

findings.evidence: Lines 9-10 are `public import TauCeti.NumberTheory.EffectiveBounds.Discriminant` and `public import TauCeti.NumberTheory.EffectiveBounds.UnitSquares`; the new class-number theorem statements use the resulting bounds only in proofs, while the visible quotient statements only need `TauCeti.ElementaryTwoQuotient`.
findings.fix: Make proof-only dependencies private imports and publicly import only the narrow modules needed by exported theorem statements, e.g. `TauCeti.Algebra.Group.ElementaryTwoQuotient` for quotient-valued statements.
findings.issue: `ClassNumber` now publicly re-exports whole `Discriminant` and `UnitSquares` modules just to prove corollaries, enlarging the public import surface for anyone importing class-number bounds.

findings.evidence: Lines 8-11 add `public import TauCeti.FieldTheory.Trace`, `Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.FiniteDimensional.Lemmas`, `Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.LinearIndependent.Lemmas`, and `Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.Monic`; the public statements at lines 154 and 199 mention only `finrank`, `algebraMap`, powers, and `NumberField.discr`, while these modules are used inside the proof.
findings.fix: Change these added imports to private imports unless a constant from them occurs in an exported statement; keep only genuinely statement-level dependencies public.
findings.issue: `Discriminant` now publicly re-exports quadratic proof machinery (`TauCeti.FieldTheory.Trace`, linear-independence lemmas, polynomial monic lemmas) that is not part of the exported discriminant theorem statements.

summary: The moved declarations preserve names, but the PR removes public module import paths and broadens parent-module re-exports with proof-only dependencies. That is a public API regression even if in-repo imports are already updated.
